question: In 2022, what time did Chahat Arora wrap up the 100 m breaststroke race at the FINA World Swimming Championships in Melbourne, Australia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 ∶13.13s**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• At the **FINA World Swimming Championships 2022 **in **Melbourne, Australia,** Indian swimmer **Chahat Arora** made headlines by establishing a national record in the women’s **100-meter breaststroke **event. 
 
• Clocking in at **1 minute and 13.13 seconds, **Arora's performance showcased her prowess in the pool. 
 
• However, Lithuania’s Ruta Meilutyte surged ahead in the overall heats with a remarkable time of 1 minute and 3.81 seconds, outpacing Arora by 9.32 seconds. 
 
• South Africa's 19-year-old Lara Van Niekerk secured second place with a time of 1 minute and 3.93 seconds, while Lilly King from the USA claimed the third spot, finishing in 1 minute and 3.94 seconds. 
 
• Looking ahead, Arora is set to participate in the women’s 50-meter breaststroke event, while Siva Sridhar will represent India in the 100-meter individual medley.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Federation Internationale de Natation (FINA) **serves as the regulatory authority for a range of aquatic sports, including swimming, diving, water polo, synchronized swimming, and open water swimming.
 
• Operating as an international non-governmental organization headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland, FINA was established on July 19, 1908, in London by eight founding entities, including British Swimming, the Hungarian Swimming Association, and the Fédération Française de Natation.
 
• Affiliated with the Association of Summer Olympic International Federations, FINA holds recognition from the International Olympic Committee for its role in overseeing international competitions within aquatic sports disciplines.
